query:
INSERT INTO chunk_version
             (id, chunk_id, version, title, content, type, tags,
              rationale, consequences, created_at)
           SELECT $1, $2, COALESCE(MAX(v.version), 0) + 1, $3, $4, $5,
                  '[]'::jsonb, $6, $7, now()
           FROM chunk_version v WHERE v.chunk_id = $2
